sentences.text: Basutodon was a pseudosuchian archosaur, a group of ancient reptiles closely related to crocodiles.
The holotype — the single specimen the species is based on — is a tooth found near Euskelosaurus browni in the upper Elliot Formation.
It is currently classified as a basal member of Suchia, though some researchers suggest it may belong to Rauisuchia.
This animal lived between 227.3 and 201.4 million years ago in the Lower Elliot Formation of Lesotho during the Norian to Rhaetian stages.
Researchers suggest that Likhoelesaurus ingens may be the same animal as Basutodon ferox.
